description: This Kotlin source file defines the HomeFragment class, a Fragment that hosts the compose-based TV Home screen. It manages focus state and handles hardware key events relevant to navigation within the TV interface.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that hosts the compose-based TV home screen and manages focus and back navigation logic.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and returns the ComposeView containing the home screen, initializing focus management.

methods.name: onHardwareKeyDown
methods.description: Handles hardware key events, can be customized to intercept specific key codes.

methods.name: handleBackPressed
methods.description: Manages back navigation to ensure focus is returned to the sidebar before exiting.
